name: Hybrid Fisher-SI Geometric Consensus
tagline: Per-parameter importance is the geometric mean of normalized EWC Fisher and SI omega; reg loss adds a clipped per-coordinate adaptive scale.

key_hyperparams.name: consensus floor
key_hyperparams.role: stabilizes geometric mean for zero terms

key_hyperparams.name: reg_strength_scale
key_hyperparams.value: set to 0.5 then immediately overridden by {} (effectively default)

init_recovers: EWC at SI=0 (then geo-mean=0); SI when Fisher=0; collapses to 0 if either is uniformly 0
diff_from_baseline: Vs EWC/SI/Online-EWC: combines Fisher and SI-omega via per-tensor mean-normalization followed by an element-wise geometric mean (a soft-AND of the two importance measures), and the regularizer further multiplies the EWC-style quadratic by an adaptive per-coordinate factor min(5, |Δθ|/Δ_ctx) tracking drift relative to the previous context's parameter change.
